name: Main
comment: 6502/2A03 instruction set, decoded via the well-known 'aaa bbb cc' encoding pattern.
Bit layout: [aaa:7-5][bbb:4-2][cc:1-0]. cc selects class (00 ctrl, 01 ALU, 10 RMW, 11 unofficial),
aaa selects op within class, bbb selects addressing mode.
Higher specificity wins over broader patterns, so individual KIL/NOP/unofficial
opcodes can shadow the broader cc patterns where needed.
comment_priority: Decoder uses first-match-wins on encoding_groups order (DecoderTable
scans formats in declaration order). So mask=0xFF entries must come
